cues.en: Hi, and welcome to this ANC-Sharp video on the Microsoft Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎收看這支介紹 Microsoft Agent Framework 的 C# AI 影片。

cues.en: Today we're going to look into Gemini and its code execution options.
cues.zh: 今天介紹 Gemini 的程式碼執行功能。

cues.en: Code execution is something OpenAI already have, but Gemini have it as well.
cues.zh: OpenAI 已經有程式碼執行，Gemini 也有。

cues.en: So let's go into it.
cues.zh: 我們開始吧。

cues.en: So let me bring up a sample here, and that sample being, under Google, Google Gemini Specific Features, Google Code Execution.
cues.zh: 先開啟 Google Gemini Specific Features 底下的 Google Code Execution 範例。

cues.en: So code execution is a way to run Python in a sandbox environment up at Google,
cues.zh: 程式碼執行就是在 Google 雲端的沙箱環境中執行 Python，

cues.en: and then either use it to do some advanced calculations, like prime numbers and something like that,
cues.zh: 可以做進階計算，例如質數相關運算，

cues.en: or use it to generate, for example, charts that you would like to get back as images in the tool.
cues.zh: 也能產生圖表，再以圖片形式取回。

cues.en: So I have both here, first being the chart, and I'm asking make a chart, use the code execution tool
cues.zh: 這裡兩種都有；第一個是圖表，要求使用 Code Execution，

cues.en: to get the top five countries by the amount of cars they produce per year.
cues.zh: 找出每年汽車產量最多的前五個國家，並製作圖表。

cues.en: So as we have seen the other tools, special tools from Gemini, of course we can use normal tool calling,
cues.zh: 和 Gemini 其他特殊工具一樣，一般函式工具當然照常使用，

cues.en: but if we need these special tools, we need to go in and do a little of the breaking glass options here, where we go into the chat client options,
cues.zh: 但若需要這些內建工具，就必須進入底層設定，在 ChatClientAgentOptions，

cues.en: the chat options, and set the raw representation factory to a generate content config.
cues.zh: 的 ChatOptions 中，讓 RawRepresentationFactory 回傳 GenerateContentConfig。

cues.en: If we do that, we can get a tool called code execution.
cues.zh: 這樣就能加入 CodeExecution 工具。

cues.en: There's nothing more to it, there's no options or anything, it's just that we get a sandbox environment that can run Python, and it can only run Python.
cues.zh: 沒有其他選項，只是取得能執行 Python 的沙箱，而且只支援 Python。

cues.en: That's very much specified in the documentation.
cues.zh: 文件有明確說明。

cues.en: But it doesn't really matter for us, we can just write it, and we can just leverage the benefit of it.
cues.zh: 不過對我們影響不大，只要透過工具使用它的能力即可。

cues.en: In this case, if we run down here to letting it run, it will now go in, use its world knowledge, find the top five countries,
cues.zh: 這個範例執行後，會根據模型已有的知識找出前五個國家，

cues.en: make some Python, and then generate an image.
cues.zh: 撰寫 Python，再產生圖片。

cues.en: And we can get the data back here, so we see the top five countries according to 2023,
cues.zh: 回覆中會有資料，這裡是根據 2023 年統計的前五個國家，

cues.en: and we can see that we spent quite a lot of tokens.
cues.zh: 而且可以看到用了不少 Token。

cues.en: Let's come back to those at the end.
cues.zh: 最後再談用量。

cues.en: If we want to know a little more about how this was taken from the world knowledge, but what Python was executed,
cues.zh: 如果想知道模型如何根據知識處理、實際執行了什麼 Python，

cues.en: and how we can get the image, we need to go in to take the response and get the raw representation factory as a chat response, and after that into a generate content response.
cues.zh: 以及如何取得圖片，就要從回覆的 RawRepresentation 取得 ChatResponse，再進一步取得 GenerateContentResponse。

cues.en: This is the Microsoft Extensions AI version, and this is the raw Google version that we need.
cues.zh: 前者是 Microsoft.Extensions.AI 的型別，後者才是需要的 Google 原生型別。

cues.en: So once we have that, we can go in and get the executable code, which in this case is this.
cues.zh: 接著可以取得 ExecutableCode，這次就是這段。

cues.en: So if you, for some reason, wanted to run the code yourself and generate the image, that would be possible.
cues.zh: 如果有需要，也能自己執行這段程式來產生圖片。

cues.en: But in line in this, there's also something called parts.
cues.zh: 同時，回覆裡還有 Parts。

cues.en: And in here, there is multiple parts of what it has done.
cues.zh: 包含這次處理的多個部分。

cues.en: So the first one being the code that you generated, then that was okay, the result of that code.
cues.zh: 第一個是生成的程式碼，再來是執行成功的狀態與結果。

cues.en: Then it gives us back the image in a blob, so we get the raw data inside here.
cues.zh: 接著以 Blob 回傳圖片，也就是這裡的原始資料。

cues.en: It seems to also have a bug that it gives that back twice.
cues.zh: 它似乎還有個問題，會回傳兩次。

cues.en: I have seen sometimes that it gives it back once, and sometimes it gives it back twice.
cues.zh: 我有時看過一次，有時是兩次。

cues.en: In our case, we get it back twice, so you need to take into account if there's multiple images and you didn't expect that.
cues.zh: 這次就有兩張，所以要考慮可能出現超出預期的圖片數量。

cues.en: And the final one is actually the text being back.
cues.zh: 最後一個部分才是文字。

cues.en: So that is what we get, and if we go in and find the parts that have inline data, so the first one didn't, the second one didn't either,
cues.zh: 這些就是回傳內容。接著尋找有 InlineData 的 Part；第一個沒有，第二個也沒有，

cues.en: and now we get to the data.
cues.zh: 現在才找到圖片資料。

cues.en: We can then make a path, in my case in my temp folder, and write all the raw bytes into that and run the image.
cues.zh: 接著建立路徑，我放在暫存資料夾，將原始位元組寫入檔案，再開啟。

cues.en: So the image looks like this, and that was generated up in the sandbox environment using Python, and sent back to us as raw bytes.
cues.zh: 圖片長這樣，是雲端沙箱用 Python 產生，再以位元組回傳的。

cues.en: If we go further, we will see that we will end up with one more image.
cues.zh: 繼續往下，會再找到一張圖片。

cues.en: Again, in my opinion, this is a bug because it's exactly the same two images, so we need to take care of that in our code,
cues.zh: 我認為這是問題，因為兩張完全一樣；目前需要自己在程式中處理，

cues.en: unfortunately, until Google fixes this.
cues.zh: 直到 Google 修正。

cues.en: But at the end, we just have our image and our text, and if we want to, our executed code.
cues.zh: 最後能取得圖片、文字，以及有需要時的實際執行程式碼。

cues.en: Another way we can use the code tool is, for example, give us the first 50 prime numbers,
cues.zh: 另一個用法，例如要求前五十個質數，

cues.en: generate them and give some calculations on them. If we do this,
cues.zh: 產生數列並做一些計算。執行後，

cues.en: we can again see that we get a response back here, and that it used a fairly amount of tokens.
cues.zh: 同樣能取得回覆，而且使用了一定數量的 Token。

cues.en: And again, we can go and get the raw contents, and we can get the executable code, so this is how it calculated the first 50 prime numbers,
cues.zh: 再取得原始內容與 ExecutableCode，就能看到它如何計算前五十個質數，

cues.en: and the raw result, if we want that for some reason, which is what this code generated.
cues.zh: 也能查看程式產生的原始執行結果。

cues.en: So we have full access to the raw data, but also just letting the AI respond back if we want to.
cues.zh: 所以原始資料全部都拿得到，也可以只讓 AI 自然回答。

cues.en: The reason why I've talked a little about the tokens, in input and output tokens here and up here,
cues.zh: 剛才一直提到上方與這裡的輸入、輸出 Token，

cues.en: is that they actually just bill you the tokens you use for code execution,
cues.zh: 是因為 Google 會依程式碼執行使用的 Token 收費，

cues.en: meaning we pay for this part of the code and so on,
cues.zh: 也就是這段程式碼等內容，

cues.en: as it was input tokens and output tokens.
cues.zh: 會當成輸入與輸出 Token 計算。

cues.en: And that's the reason why these are fairly high, but of course still being good that it can do this.
cues.zh: 因此數量看起來比較高，但有這個功能仍然很方便。

cues.en: And this deviates from OpenAI, where you actually need to pay per session you run.
cues.zh: 這和 OpenAI 不同，OpenAI 需要依執行 session 支付費用。

cues.en: Google have decided to say, okay, we pay tokens, but we don't pay for you to run a sandbox environment.
cues.zh: Google 選擇只收 Token，不另外收沙箱執行費。

cues.en: They take the charts on that and instead bill you in tokens, which I think will be much cheaper than actually paying
cues.zh: 他們自行承擔沙箱環境成本，改由 Token 計費；我認為這通常比直接支付，

cues.en: for the container apps running up in the cloud.
cues.zh: 雲端容器的執行費更便宜。

cues.en: In my book, that is a better solution and a cheaper solution for us, but of course if you make some very, very advanced stuff, you pay a lot of tokens in that code execution.
cues.zh: 對我們來說，這是更好的計費方式；當然，如果產生非常進階的程式，仍會使用很多 Token。

cues.en: But that's actually everything there is to it.
cues.zh: 基本內容就是這些。

cues.en: We still need to do breaking glass like this, but beyond that, it's very simple to just use, and then a little cumbersome to get out again from the system.
cues.zh: 雖然要透過原生設定加入工具，但使用很簡單，只是取出結果時稍微繁瑣。

cues.en: But that's everything. See you on the next one.
cues.zh: 這次就到這裡，我們下支影片見。
